scripts.lint: bun run src/design-lint.ts src && bun run src/badge-lint.ts src && bun run src/token-lint.ts
scripts.build: bun run lint && bunx tsc --noEmit && bun run src/index.ts && bun run src/script-lint.ts dist/index.html dist/404.html dist/viewer.html
scripts.dev: bun run build && bun run stage && bunx wrangler@4 dev
scripts.deploy: bun run build && bun run stage && bunx wrangler@4 deploy
scripts.serve: bun run build && bun run src/serve.ts
